description: 기후에너지환경부 국립환경과학원_전기차 1회충전주행거리 인증정보 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기후에너지환경부 국립환경과학원. 환경부 국립환경과학원에서 전기차 1회충전주행거리 인증정보를 제공하며, 항목으로는 1회충전주행거리 상온 조건의 도심/고속/복합, 저온 조건의 도심/고속/복합, 업체명, 배출가스 인증번호. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기후에너지환경부 국립환경과학원. Its tags are 전기차, 1회충전주행거리, 자동차환경인증, 전기이륜차, 전기상용차. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-05-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
